directions.name: Editorial Warmth
directions.summary: A small-press magazine feel: light condensed serif with one italic word, warm cream paper, terracotta accents and photos that sit inset like printed plates.

typography.display: Light, slightly condensed transitional serif with a true italic used for one accent word per headline. Google: Instrument Serif (400 + italic); alt Newsreader (opsz 72, wght 300).
typography.body: Quiet humanist/grotesk sans at 16-17px. Google: Instrument Sans 400/500.
typography.details: Headlines sentence case, 56-80px, tracking -0.01em, line-height 1.0-1.05. Eyebrows and stat captions in DM Mono 11px uppercase, tracking +0.12em, often prefixed with a section number ('02 · Services'). Stats in the display serif at 32-40px over mono captions.

palette.notes: Cream page, no pure white anywhere. Terracotta carries the CTA and the second line of a two-tone headline; plum (or terracotta) only on the italic accent word. Dark ink pill button rather than a colored one for the primary CTA.

directions.shape: Image plates with 16-20px radius or an arch-topped crop; buttons as 999px pills; 1px hairline rules (~#D9CDBB) between sections instead of colored bands; no drop shadows except a very soft one under a single floating card.
directions.layout_personality: Asymmetric split hero (text 5 cols, image 6-7 cols) or a photo inset with page margin all round and the headline set over it. Generous whitespace (120-160px section padding), left-aligned text, numbered section headers that run as a rule + label + headline line.
directions.imagery: Warm, naturally lit, slightly desaturated photos of finished rooms, materials and hands at work; shot close with shallow depth. Inset with margin rather than full bleed.
signature_details: Two-tone headline: first line ink, second line terracotta (or one italic word in plum)
Section numbering in mono ('01 · About', '02 · Pricing') sitting on a hairline rule
Crop marks / corner ticks on the hero image card and a tiny mono caption like 'Job 014 · Kitchen'
Stat trio with serif numerals and mono uppercase captions, separated by a hairline above
Arch-topped or inset photo plate with a small floating detail card overlapping its edge

references.what: Condensed light serif with an italic plum accent word, mono numbered section labels, stat trio with mono captions, crop-mark corners on the image card, cream paper throughout.
Photo inset with margin on a warm greige page, soft wedge serif set large across the photo, serif wordmark and pill CTA in terracotta.
Two-tone serif headline (ink + terracotta), arch-topped hero photo with a floating detail card, dark trust strip along the hero's bottom edge.
Tan-over-black two-tone headline on cream, tan check circles in the bullet list, rounded photo mosaic on the right.

directions.name: Cinematic Horizon
directions.summary: Big-sky, full-viewport landscape or aerial photography with a calm white serif headline centered in the light, like an opening film still.

typography.display: Sharp, light transitional serif, high contrast but sturdy. Google: Newsreader (opsz 72, wght 300-400); alt Source Serif 4 Display 300.
typography.body: Neutral grotesk at 16-18px, light on dark photo. Google: Hanken Grotesk 400.
typography.details: Hero headline 60-88px centered, sentence case, tracking -0.02em. One mono eyebrow above it in Fragment Mono 11px uppercase, tracking +0.18em, white at 70% opacity. Body under the headline max 46ch, centered.

palette.notes: The photo is the palette: dusk blues, warm roof terracotta, green hills. A 20-40% charcoal gradient from the top and bottom keeps type legible. One saturated accent (orange) only on the primary CTA in the nav. Sections below the hero switch to a light warm surface with dark ink.

directions.shape: Floating nav as a white rounded-rect pill (12px radius) inset 16px from the top; buttons 999px pills, one solid, one ghost with 1px white outline; content panels below with 12px radius; no hard borders.
directions.layout_personality: Full-viewport hero, everything centered on one axis. Low density: headline, one line of body, two buttons. Below the fold, alternate a calm light section with another edge-to-edge photo band. Section transitions sometimes fade the photo into the page color instead of a hard edge.
directions.imagery: Aerial drone shots of neighborhoods and rooflines, wide landscapes at golden hour or blue hour, misty valleys; minimal people. Color graded warm highlights / cool shadows.
signature_details: Detached white nav pill floating over the photo with the only orange button on the page
Mono uppercase eyebrow ('THE SERVICE AREA') centered above a light serif headline
Photo bottom edge dissolving into the page color via a soft gradient
Ghost button with 1px white outline paired with a solid one
Second full-bleed photo band mid-page carrying a single quote or number

references.what: Aerial dusk photo of suburban rooftops, light white serif centered, mono eyebrow, floating white nav pill with a single orange CTA. Closest existing match to a solar/roofing hero.
Thin serif across a deep-blue sky photo; black solid pill + white-outline ghost pill pairing.
Photo that fades into the page background through a misty gradient, serif headline sitting on the fade.
Edge-to-edge winding-road landscape with a centered headline and a translucent dark pill CTA.

directions.name: Jobsite Industrial
directions.summary: Tall condensed caps, concrete and black, hi-vis yellow and safety orange: built like signage on a work truck or a tool catalog.

typography.display: Heavy condensed grotesk, all caps. Google: Big Shoulders Display 800-900; alt Anton.
typography.details: Display 72-140px, uppercase, tracking 0 to -0.01em, line-height 0.9. Labels, nav and buttons in Barlow Condensed 600 uppercase 13-14px, tracking +0.06em. Numbers (phone, license, years) set in the display face.

palette.notes: Warm concrete page with full-width black bands. Hi-vis yellow for CTA fills and highlight bars; safety orange only for the urgent action (emergency call, nav CTA). Never more than two accents; photos are allowed to be gritty.

directions.shape: Square corners everywhere (0-2px radius). Buttons are rectangles with a long arrow glyph. 2px solid black rules; white rectangular label boxes laid over photos; optional diagonal hazard-stripe strip as a divider.
directions.layout_personality: Dense and confident. Left-aligned giant headline that may run edge to edge, a photo triptych band, and stacked full-width bands alternating concrete and black. Service list as a numbered spec table rather than cards.
directions.imagery: Real crews, trucks, ladders, tools and materials in daylight; high contrast, slightly gritty. Product-style cutouts of equipment (a condenser, a door panel) on flat concrete backgrounds.
signature_details: White rectangular caption boxes stamped directly on photos ('STORM DAMAGE' / 'Fast fix in one visit')
Square outline buttons with a long horizontal arrow (⟶)
Single safety-orange block button in the nav for the phone number
Mono-weight condensed tags like 'EST. 1998 · LIC #12345' in the hero corner
Thin vertical hairline dropping from the hero CTA toward the next section

references.what: Ultra-condensed heavy black caps on warm cream with a product cutout and lots of empty space.
Condensed caps in white label boxes laid over photos, square buttons with long arrows, black/white triptych photo band.
Black field, one orange-red square CTA in the nav, mono caps nav, white square button, thin vertical line dropping from the CTA.
Gritty dark photo, condensed caps display, single hi-vis block CTA, tracked mono tags, vertical 'SCROLL DOWN' rail text, segmented tab filter.

directions.name: Poster Pop
directions.summary: Loud, warm and friendly: giant colored condensed headline on cream, sticker shapes, cobalt pills, like a screen-printed neighborhood poster.

typography.display: Chunky condensed grotesk with personality (ink traps, tight counters), all caps or title case. Google: Bricolage Grotesque (wdth 75, wght 800); alt Big Shoulders Display 900.
typography.body: Friendly geometric-humanist sans at 16-17px. Google: Onest 400/500.
typography.details: Display 96-160px, line-height 0.88, tracking -0.01em, set in the accent color (not black). May be slightly rotated (-4 to -6deg) or skewed. Buttons and nav in Onest 600 sentence case.

palette.notes: Cream page; the headline itself is the color (tomato orange). Cobalt blue for the secondary pill buttons and links; navy ink for body. Optional third pop (teal ~#3CC7B8 or sunflower ~#FFC93C) used only in stickers.

directions.shape: Fully rounded pills for nav and buttons; hero panel as a big rounded rectangle (24-32px) inset from the page; sticker shapes with a white 4px keyline and soft shadow; offset solid-color block behind photos.
directions.layout_personality: Headline-first hero taking 60% width, stacked tight; supporting copy and CTA in a narrow right column or below. Elements overlap: stickers sit across headline letters, photos have an offset color block behind them. Medium density, playful asymmetry.
directions.imagery: Bright, real people photos cut out or framed, combined with flat illustrated stickers (sun, bug, droplet, sparkle). Illustration can be overlaid on the photo as in a collage.
signature_details: Giant colored condensed headline that bleeds to the left margin, sometimes skewed
Sticker badges with white keylines placed across the headline (sun, sparkle, droplet)
Photo with a solid cobalt offset block behind it
Trust row under CTAs: small icon + bold number + label ('2.5M+ jobs done')
White pill nav cluster floating top-right with one solid orange pill

references.what: Huge orange condensed caps stacked down the left on cream, keylined sticker illustrations over the type, white pill nav, cobalt pill CTA.
Skewed condensed navy headline 'GET MORE DONE' inside a rounded cream panel, illustrated cobalt boxes collaged onto a photo, offset navy block, trust stat row.
Heavy black wide grotesk headline, single orange CTA, chamfered/angled photo crop instead of rounded corners.
Flat geometric sticker shapes in a clashing warm palette framing a single black label CTA.

directions.name: Swiss Grid
directions.summary: White page, black neo-grotesk set huge and tight on a visible grid, with a red registration mark as the only color: precise and quietly expensive.

typography.display: Neo-grotesk, bold to extra-bold, mixed-case or caps. Google: Schibsted Grotesk 700-800; alt Archivo 700.
typography.body: Same family at 400, 17-20px, used for a large 'mission' paragraph as well as normal copy.
typography.details: Display 96-180px, tracking -0.045em, line-height 0.9, often edge to edge. Micro labels in JetBrains Mono 10-11px uppercase (nav, coordinates, local time, '(Scroll)'). Large lead paragraph at 28-32px with -0.02em tracking and a hanging indent.

palette.notes: Monochrome. Signal red appears only as '+' registration marks, a small square CTA and link hovers (under 2% of the surface). No tinted backgrounds except a single light grey surface for forms.

directions.shape: 0 radius. 1px black or #E2E2E2 rules; '+' crosshair marks at grid intersections; square buttons with an attached square arrow box.
directions.layout_personality: 12-column grid made visible through alignment and crosshairs. Headline top-left spanning the full width; small meta (city, local time, license) in the nav row; mission paragraph starting at column 7. Long vertical rhythm, very few elements per screen, index-style numbered service lists.
directions.imagery: Sparse. Black-and-white or cool, flat-lit architectural detail photos (switch plates, ductwork, stair rails) cropped square; never stock smiles.
signature_details: Red '+' crosshairs marking grid corners
Nav row with live local time / city ('Toronto 4:31 am') and '(Scroll)' cue
Square red CTA with a separate square arrow cell
Indented first line on the big mission paragraph with a tiny mono label in the indent
Footer meta row: '©2026 / Terms / IG / LI' in mono

references.what: Heavy tight grotesk caps on white, location + local time in the nav, '(Scroll)' cue bottom-right, two-tone grey/black intro paragraph.
Edge-to-edge caps headline, red crosshair registration marks, mission paragraph on the right half with mono label in its indent, square red CTA + arrow cell.
Staggered giant caps lines with indents, tiny mono nav in the corners, footer meta row; shows how far scale contrast can go.

directions.name: Blueprint Spec
directions.summary: A technical spec sheet: monospace caps, bracketed buttons, guide lines, footnotes and measurements, for trades that sell precision.

typography.display: Condensed or regular monospace in caps, typewriter feel. Google: Martian Mono (wdth 75-87, wght 500-600); alt IBM Plex Mono 500.
typography.body: Technical grotesk at 15-16px. Google: IBM Plex Sans 400.
typography.details: Display 56-96px uppercase, tracking -0.02em. All labels, nav, buttons and numbers in IBM Plex Mono 11-12px uppercase, tracking +0.04em. Footnote markers [1] and units (BTU, AMP, PSI) set as superscripts.

palette.notes: Cool drafting-paper grey with black ink. Blueprint blue for links, active states and diagram lines; copper only in photography and a single highlight (wire / pipe). A dark variant flips to charcoal ~#16181B with the same accents.

directions.shape: Square or 2-4px radius; 1px outlined boxes for nav items and buttons; thin vertical guide lines running the full page height; tick-mark rulers along a margin; dashed leader lines connecting labels to photo details.
directions.layout_personality: Engineering-drawing layout: content in a framed center column between guide lines, small spec blocks pinned to corners (left: 'Designed & installed in Austin, TX'; right: '100% licensed / 0 subcontractors'). Process shown as a line diagram with pill labels. Medium density, everything labelled.
directions.imagery: Macro detail shots of craft: copper windings, panel breakers, pipe joints, duct seams; neutral color grade; presented with a thumbnail strip like a parts catalog.
signature_details: Bracketed text buttons: [BOOK SERVICE] [CALL 24/7]
Footnote markers [1] in the hero with the footnote set in mono at the page bottom
Full-height hairline guide lines and a tick-mark ruler down the left margin
Spec list with right-aligned values ('Response time ...... 60 MIN')
Process diagram: thin curved lines branching to pill labels (Inspect / Quote / Install / Test)

references.what: Typewriter mono caps headline, bracketed black buttons, corner spec blocks, footnote marker [1] and right-aligned spec list.
Charcoal page with thin vertical guide lines, outlined boxed nav, macro photo of copper coils, catalog thumbnail strip. Very direct cue for electricians.
Left-margin time ruler with tick marks framing stacked panels: a scheduling/appointments motif.
Monospace body and nav, process diagram drawn as thin curved lines meeting at pill labels.

directions.name: Nocturne Premium
directions.summary: Near-black, refined serif with an italic turn, hairline geometry and warm low light: for high-ticket jobs that want to feel like a private studio.

typography.display: Elegant old-style serif with a beautiful italic. Google: Cormorant Garamond 500-600 (italic for one word); alt Libre Caslon Display.
typography.body: Light grotesk at 15-16px in muted grey. Google: Geist 300/400.
typography.details: Display 64-104px, centered or left, tracking -0.01em, line-height 1.0. Nav and eyebrows in Geist Mono 11px uppercase, tracking +0.14em. Body copy at 60% white.

palette.notes: Black and bone white with a single warm brass/amber used as light (a glow behind a photo, a hairline, a hover), never as a big fill. Primary button is bone white with black text.

directions.shape: Hairline 1px rules at 12% white; small 6-8px radius on buttons or full pills; thin outlined circles/arcs as decoration; dark boxed nav items; no shadows, only glow.
directions.layout_personality: Very low density: one statement per screen, centered serif headline, generous black space. Split sections with dark text panel beside a full-height photo. Stat row at hero bottom separated by vertical hairlines.
directions.imagery: Moody, low-key photography: lit kitchens at night, landscape lighting, a single warm lamp; silhouettes against amber light. Black-and-white for portraits.
signature_details: One italic word in the serif headline ('Revolutionizing wealth...' pattern)
Hairline geometric drawing (overlapping circles, hatched intersection) below the hero
Warm amber radial glow behind a silhouette photo
Stat row with vertical hairline separators along the bottom of the hero
Mono breadcrumb eyebrow ('SERVICES / OUTDOOR LIGHTING')

references.what: Large white serif centered on near-black, small caps eyebrow, hairline Venn circles with hatched intersection as the only ornament.
Serif headline with an italic first word, mono caps nav in dark boxed pills, bone-white CTA.
Silhouette against an amber glow, left-aligned headline, three-up stat row split by vertical hairlines.
Dark text panel beside a full-height photo, mono breadcrumb eyebrow, monochrome logo row.

directions.name: Field Guide
directions.summary: Deep olive and moss fields, soft serif headlines and big landscape imagery, with an orange trail-marker accent: the outdoors as a printed guidebook.

typography.display: Soft, slightly wonky old-style serif at light-regular weight. Google: Fraunces (opsz 144, wght 300-400, SOFT 50); alt Young Serif.
typography.body: Plain humanist sans at 16-17px. Google: Work Sans 400.
typography.details: Display 56-88px sentence case, tracking -0.015em, centered on color fields or left on photos. Nav and eyebrows in Antonio (condensed) 600 uppercase 12-13px, tracking +0.12em; used also for coordinates/area tags ('ZONE 7B · TRAVIS COUNTY').

palette.notes: Hero and key bands on deep olive with cream type; content sections on pale sage with olive ink. Trail-orange only for the primary CTA and map pins. Secondary button is a muted olive-grey fill, not outlined.

directions.shape: Square-to-slight (0-4px) radius on buttons; rectangular photos with no radius; organic topographic blob or contour-line shape partly behind the nav; list rows separated by 1px hairlines with a right arrow.
directions.layout_personality: Centered serif statement on a solid green field, followed by a wide landscape photo or full-bleed hero with condensed caps. Service areas or projects as hairline list rows (name / place / region / →). Calm, medium-low density.
directions.imagery: Wide landscapes, lawns, gardens, tree canopies and misty hills; natural color with slightly lifted shadows. Real crews in the field shown small in the frame.
signature_details: Topographic contour blob tucked behind the logo/nav
List rows like a trail index: Project · Neighborhood · County · → on hairlines
Condensed caps area tags and coordinates as eyebrows
Orange triangular play/arrow glyph inside the CTA
Spaced-caps wordmark (F A I R E style) in the nav

references.what: Deep olive hero, light serif centered in cream, orange CTA with arrow glyph + muted olive secondary, topographic shape behind the nav, caps nav.
Mountain landscape hero with centered condensed caps, vertical rail text on the right edge, hairline list rows with origin / region / country / arrow.
Olive-brown band with light white serif centered, spaced-caps wordmark, then a full-width photo of a small business at work.
Pale sage page, condensed serif in slate, spaced-caps nav, mono 'WELCOME TO' label beside an inset misty landscape photo.

directions.name: Market Fresh
directions.summary: Fresh and dependable: cream page, forest-green ink, sage tint bands, hairline borders and a lime pill, like a good neighborhood grocer.

typography.display: Wide, friendly geometric sans at bold weight. Google: Lexend 600-700; alt Gabarito 700.
typography.body: Clean humanist sans at 16px. Google: Figtree 400/500.
typography.details: Headlines 40-64px, tracking -0.02em, sentence case. Small eyebrows in Figtree 600 11-12px uppercase, tracking +0.08em ('NEW', 'SAME-WEEK SERVICE'). Prices and specs in tabular figures with uppercase units ('$149   2 HRS').

palette.notes: Forest green is the brand ink (logo, headings, primary dark buttons). Sage tint for alternating bands and cards. Lime pill reserved for the single most important action. Tiny pink-red tag (~#F3D5CF bg / ~#B5442F text) for warnings like 'Pets: use caution'.

directions.shape: Cards 16-20px radius on a tinted surface (no shadow); pill buttons; full-width 1px hairline rules (~#C9D3C6) dividing hero halves and bands; pill tabs for category filters.
directions.layout_personality: Split hero: text panel left, edge-to-edge photo right, divided by hairlines top and bottom. Service menu as a 3-4 column card grid with eyebrow, name, short description, price/duration. Category pill tabs above lists. Medium density, very scannable.
directions.imagery: Bright, true-color photos of hands at work and clean results; overhead shots of tools/products on surfaces; no heavy grading.
signature_details: Lime pill CTA on cream with forest-green text
Tinted service cards with tracked uppercase eyebrow and price + duration line
Pill tab filter row ('Lawn · Gardens · Trees · Irrigation')
Hairline-framed split hero with a phone line under the CTA ('Questions? Call (555) 273-3356')
Dark green outlined price card with a small lime 'Great value' corner tag

references.what: Cream page, tinted rounded cards, uppercase tracked eyebrows, price + spec line, pill tab filter and small warning tag.
Split hero divided by hairlines, wide bold sans headline in forest green, lime pill CTA, sage band below.
Beige hero band, dark green outlined price card with corner value tag, phone consult line under the headline, green pill CTA.
Deep green ink headline on white, dark green pill with outline glow, row of check-mark microcopy under CTAs.

directions.name: Soft Rounded
directions.summary: Gentle and reassuring: blush, peach and butter color fields, big rounded cards, a soft serif headline and dark-cocoa ink.

typography.display: Soft, rounded-terminal serif, regular-to-semibold. Google: Young Serif 400; alt Fraunces (SOFT 100, wght 500).
typography.body: Rounded-feeling humanist sans at 16-17px. Google: Nunito Sans 400/600.
typography.details: Headlines 40-64px sentence case, tracking -0.01em, centered inside color cards. Body 16-17px with 1.6 line-height. Category words colored inside headings ('Drain cleaning', 'Water heaters' with the second word tinted).

palette.notes: Warm off-white page with large peach/salmon, blush (~#F6E3E0) and butter fields as section backgrounds. Cocoa-brown ink and cocoa pill buttons inside color cards; a friendly blue pill for the main page CTA.

directions.shape: Generous radii: cards 24-32px, photos 20-24px, buttons full pills. Soft cloud/blob shapes behind photos; curved wave dividers between bands instead of straight edges; no hard borders.
directions.layout_personality: Content floats in big rounded color cards on an off-white page. Hero: left text with check-list bullets, right a layered pair of rounded photos with blobs. Service grid as large rounded tiles with an object/illustration and arrow. Medium density, centered CTA cards.
directions.imagery: Smiling, natural-light photos of people at home; simple line-drawn characters for empty states and CTAs; soft-shadow product/object cutouts on tiles.
signature_details: Salmon rounded CTA card with a tiny line-drawn character above a serif headline
Layered rounded photos with a soft cloud blob peeking from behind
Wave-shaped band divider
Rounded service tiles with a two-color title and a corner arrow
Pill 'Popular' tag inside the first tile

references.what: Salmon rounded card on off-white, soft serif headline in cocoa, line-drawn character, cocoa pill button.
Cream rounded tiles with two-color titles, soft-shadow object cutouts, 'Popular' pill, two-tone headline.
Blush band, layered rounded photos with cloud blobs, check-list bullets, big blue pill CTA.
Rounded heavy sans, wave-shaped divider between the green band and white page, chunky rounded button.

directions.name: Heritage Ledger
directions.summary: Established and trustworthy: classic book serif in oxblood-brown on paper, ledger rules, mono figures, a signature script and torn-document details.

typography.display: Classic old-style / Caslon-type serif, regular weight. Google: Libre Caslon Display (headlines) with Libre Caslon Text for subheads.
typography.body: Classic American gothic sans at 16-17px. Google: Libre Franklin 400; or a serif body in Libre Caslon Text for long copy.
typography.details: Headlines 48-76px, sentence case, tracking -0.01em, centered or left. Figures (years, license numbers, invoice-style tables) in Courier Prime 12-13px. One handwritten eyebrow per page in a signature script (Google: Homemade Apple or Caveat), rotated -2deg.

palette.notes: Paper white and ledger tan, espresso ink, oxblood for buttons and rules; deep navy as an optional heritage alternate for the footer, badges and 'Est.' seal. Never bright colors.

directions.shape: 2-4px radius buttons (nearly square) in oxblood or espresso; ledger tables with 1px rules (~#D8CBBB); torn/deckled paper edges on document fragments; small circular engraved-style emblem or seal.
directions.layout_personality: Centered serif headline over a two-column body (a letter-like paragraph left, a short statement right). Proof shown as document fragments: invoice/warranty excerpts, ledger tables, signed notes. Narrow measure, generous margins, slow rhythm.
directions.imagery: Portraits of the owner/family cut out over torn paper, black-and-white archive shots of the first truck or shop, engraved/etched illustrations of tools or the house.
signature_details: Ledger table fragment with mono figures pinned to the hero corner ('Since 1987 · 12,400 roofs')
Torn-paper warranty or invoice excerpt behind a cutout portrait
Handwritten script eyebrow ('For homeowners in Westchester')
Engraved coin/seal emblem with founding year
Didone-style wordmark with an em dash ('A— BUREAU' pattern) and a short attributed quote

references.what: Espresso classic serif centered on paper, ledger table with mono figures, torn-paper document fragment, engraved coin cutout, two-column letter-like body.
Handwritten script eyebrow above the serif headline, cutout portrait on torn paper with handwritten letter, near-square dark brown buttons.
Didone caps wordmark with em dash, single narrow column on warm paper, attributed quote, plain architectural photo.

directions.name: Wide Stance
directions.summary: Modern contractor confidence: extra-wide heavy display in navy and slate, rounded photo plates, solid navy blocks and hard numbers.

typography.display: Extended (wide) heavy grotesk. Google: Archivo (wdth 125, wght 800-900); alt Unbounded 700.
typography.body: Neutral modern sans at 16px. Google: Manrope 400/500.
typography.details: Display 64-96px, lowercase or sentence case, tracking -0.02em, line-height 0.95; second half of the headline in slate grey. Stats in the extended face at 28-36px with Manrope 13px labels. Small 'Est. 2009' pill badge with a location pin above the headline.

palette.notes: White page, navy as both ink and the solid block color (full-width bands, stat tiles, primary pill button). Slate for the second headline line and secondary text. A warm brass/amber may mark one highlight (rating stars, active tab).

directions.shape: Photo plates 20-28px radius; navy pill buttons with an arrow-up-right glyph; outlined white pill for secondary; navy rounded stat tiles inside the photo grid; no shadows.
directions.layout_personality: Two-column hero: big stacked wide headline left, tall rounded photo right, stat trio under the CTAs. Portfolio as a bento grid mixing photos with a navy number tile. Full-width navy band with a heavy white statement left and two-column body right.
directions.imagery: Clean, bright, architectural photos of finished interiors and exteriors (kitchens, garages, facades) with warm wood tones against cool neutrals.
signature_details: Two-tone wide headline: navy first lines, slate last lines
Navy stat tile ('32 projects across the metro') sitting inside the photo grid
'Est. 2009' pill with location pin above the headline
Arrow-up-right glyph in every pill button
Full-width navy manifesto band with heavy white headline and two-column copy

references.what: Extended heavy headline with navy/slate two-tone, 'Premium real estate · Est. 2009' pill, rounded kitchen photo, stat trio, navy pill with arrow.
Portfolio bento grid mixing rounded photos with a navy number tile, small caps 'THE PORTFOLIO' label, wide headline.
Navy rounded hero card beside the headline and a full-width navy band with heavy white statement + two-column body.
Wide geometric display in a solid dark panel beside a full-height photo; shows the extended face working on dark.

directions.name: Workshop Craft
directions.summary: Rugged and hand-made: chunky slab serif on grainy kraft paper, torn edges, stitched borders and real crew photos with name tags.

typography.display: Chunky slab or soft heavy serif. Google: Zilla Slab 700; alt Bitter 800.
typography.body: Plain workhorse grotesk at 16-17px. Google: Public Sans 400/500.
typography.details: Headlines 48-80px, sentence case or lowercase, tracking -0.01em, tight line-height. Stamp labels in Zilla Slab 600 uppercase 12px tracking +0.1em. Photo name tags in Public Sans 600 12px.

palette.notes: Kraft/oatmeal paper with a subtle film-grain or paper texture (2-4% noise). Tobacco-brown ink, rust for CTAs, pine green for framed color panels and the footer. Colors feel dyed, not digital.

directions.shape: Torn/deckled paper edge where a text panel meets a photo; dashed 'stitched' 2px borders around feature panels; framed color panels with a cream border (8-12px) inside the page; 4-6px radius buttons; no glossy shadows.
directions.layout_personality: Half-and-half hero: textured paper panel with headline and form left, full-height real crew photo right joined by a torn edge. Feature panels look like patches or labels. Medium density, slightly irregular but aligned.
directions.imagery: Unretouched real tradespeople on the job and in their trucks, tools and materials, warm documentary color; every photo can carry a caption tag with the person's name, company and town.
signature_details: Torn paper edge between the text panel and the hero photo
Caption tag on photos: name / business / town with a pin icon
Dashed stitched border around a colored feature panel
Cream-framed pine-green panel holding a chunky serif statement
Film-grain texture over flat color fields and the wordmark

references.what: Paper-textured left panel with a torn edge into a real electrician-in-his-van photo, caption tag with name / company / city, heavy dark headline, lime CTA.
